summary_en: ACDT #70 set bal-devnet-3 for March 4. nerolation submitted a simpler cap for block level access lists after the earlier max items cap PR merged. The agenda for the first Encrypt The Mempool call was posted. deiu submitted an Agent Subscription ERC.
